notes: Fixes Gemini replies interrupting themselves when speaker output leaked into the microphone. Local and browser mic audio is now kept out of the provider while Chat speaks, while intentional barge-in still transitions safely back to listening and delayed model audio is discarded. Also fixes LG TV power-on requests falsely reporting already on when the WebOS socket remained connected after power-off; Wake-on-LAN is now sent unless live power state is positively on or active. Includes Chat YouTube Companion 1.0.7.
